source.title: Periods of Integrals on Algebraic Manifolds: Summary of Main Results and Discussion of Open Problems

accepted.question_text: For a period mapping from a smooth algebraic family whose period matrix domain D is a bounded domain and whose arithmetic monodromy quotient is D/T, does Borel's extension theorem remain valid for smooth compactifications of the base whose boundary is not assumed to have normal crossings? Equivalently, in what sense is D/T minimal at infinity independently of the chosen smooth compactification?

evidence.quote: it is not known whether or not (6.6) remains true for other smooth compactifications of 5
i.e. it is not known in what sense D/T is "minimal at infinity"

accepted.question_text: Find methods for proving or disproving local Torelli theorems for algebraic varieties, where the local Torelli problem asks whether the Hodge structure on the cohomology of a fiber separates points in its local moduli (Kuranishi) space. In particular, determine whether the local Torelli theorem is true or false for simply connected canonical surfaces, meaning surfaces with ample canonical bundle.

evidence.quote: The local Torelli problem is the question of deciding when the Hodge structure on 2J*(F8, C) separates points in the local moduli space
Find methods to treat the local Torelli theorem. In particular, decide whether it is true or false for simply-connected canonical surfaces
